notes.title: GOST of Time – Official Game Launch on October 10, 2024
notes.notes:
Hello folks! It's been a while (2 years) since my last post, but I'm happy to announce that I’ve wrapped up my game featuring a time-travel mechanic where you collect pills for Grandpa. The release is October 10, 2024! Thanks to everyone who believed in and supported me.

Cheers!
[previewyoutube=d9N_h_JrV0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: GOST of Time - Kazakhsky LIVE-STREAM
notes.notes:
Hello folks! Welcome to Kazakh broadcast. We will play a demo version of GOST OF Time - a top-down, time travel game where players must use their dead bodies to solve the puzzles to get pills for grandfather.

We will discuss how we came up with the idea of where the main mechanic is to kill yourself, why frogs and what it is GOST (it's not a Ghost). And we're open to your time travel ideas on how we can improve the game. So welcome to our very cozy stream.

Let's play, tell jokes about time travel and the gaming industry and drink koumiss!
